input_file.description: Path to the media file to analyze

use_full_info.description: If true, displays full information (all internal tags)

use_xml.description: If true, outputs in XML format

use_html.description: If true, outputs in HTML format

use_inform.description: If true, uses custom Inform template for output

inform_sections.description: List of sections and parameters for Inform output. Each item is a map with 'section' and 'param' keys.

log_file.description: Path to save the output log. If empty, no log is saved.
